description: One of several attempts at the SAME piece of work, shown beside its rivals so a reader can compare them and pick a winner: what it is called, the state it ended in, the score it earned, the votes recorded on it and its own summary. The record is a VALUE and carries no state of its own: the winner is either named by the host (BestAttemptId on the surface) or derived from the highest Score by ParallelAttemptRanking. A component never mutates an attempt and never invents a score. The attempt's own body is deliberately NOT part of the model: a surface renders it through a template, so a diff, a document, a code block or plain prose all fit without the library knowing what an attempt contains.

members.name: Abstentions
members.description: How many voters abstained (including a score-only vote).

members.name: Approvals
members.description: How many voters approved the attempt.

members.name: HasLabel
members.description: Whether the host supplied a label.

members.name: HasRationales
members.description: Whether at least one voter explained their verdict.

members.name: HasScore
members.description: Whether a usable score was supplied (a non-finite value counts as none).

members.name: HasSummary
members.description: Whether the host supplied a summary worth printing.

members.name: HasVotes
members.description: Whether at least one vote was recorded.

members.name: Id
members.description: Stable identity of the attempt. Never empty: a missing id is generated at construction.

members.name: Label
members.description: What distinguishes this attempt. Empty renders the surface's own numbered fallback.

members.name: Rejections
members.description: How many voters rejected the attempt.

members.name: Score
members.description: The score the host (or a grader) gave the attempt, on the host's own scale. null means "not scored", not zero; the ranking ignores an unscored attempt unless the host names it explicitly.

members.name: Status
members.description: The state the attempt ended in. Default Idle; painted as an icon, a localized word and a tone, and an attempt that is still running or failed can never win a comparison by accident.

members.name: Summary
members.description: The attempt's own short summary — what it would be chosen FOR. Empty renders none; the full body comes from the surface's content template.

members.name: VoteCount
members.description: How many votes the attempt carries.
